messages:
Alex Chen: Quick heads-up — we have a micro-webinar (30m) on 2025-09-22 aimed at developer PMs. Need final social plan + seedlist by EOD today. Who can pick creative + X/LinkedIn copy?
Maria Gupta: I can pull together copy. Do we want a single thread or a staggered drip across X + LI?
Jonah Lee: Staggered. X: 3 tweets + short thread at T-0. LI: 1 post + follow-up comment at +1hr. Time windows: 11am PT and 2pm PT.
Priya Nair: Targeting = product/infra PMs + ML platform folks. I'll export a segmented seedlist (priority: startup PMs, then mid-market). Link to draft CSV will be in the thread.
Emmy Park: I can handle engagement follow-ups (reply playbook + SDR handoff). Need final CTA + tracking UTMs. Can we standardize the follow-up DM template?
Alex Chen: Thanks. CTA = "Join live — limited seats" with registration link https://redwood.ai/webinar/micro-serve 
Alex Chen: Suggested UTMs: utm_source=twitter|linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=microwebinar_sep2025
Maria Gupta: Draft copy for X: 
```
1) Headline tweet: "How to make LLM inference 10x cheaper in production — join our 30m micro-webinar on 9/22. RSVP: https://redwood.ai/webinar/micro-serve #LLM #DevTools"
2) Thread follow (reply 1): "We’ll cover batching, caching, and quantization tradeoffs that actually move the needle."
3) Thread follow (reply 2): "Live Q&A + artifacts. Seats limited — register now."
```
Maria Gupta: LinkedIn copy (single post): "Production inference matters. Join our 30-minute micro-webinar on 9/22 to learn practical levers to cut inference cost and latency. RSVP: https://redwood.ai/webinar/micro-serve"
Jonah Lee: Can we A/B the headline on X? Variant A: cost focus. Variant B: latency focus. We should post A at 11:00 PT and B at 11:10 PT from different accounts/pinned boosters.
Priya Nair: Seedlist (draft): https://drive.google.com/seedlist/microwebinar_sep2025.csv — contains emails, org size, region. I’ll add a column for SDR priority (1/2/3).
Emmy Park: Reply playbook (short): 
- Quick answer to registration Qs
- If they ask pricing, link to pricing page + invite to trial
- Mark as inbound if they click registration but don’t attend -> SDR follow-up within 24h
Emmy Park: DM template for SDR handoff: "Thanks for registering — we'd love to learn about your stack. Mind sharing your team size & infra?"
Amanda O'Neill: Logistics: Are there embargo windows or regional posting times? Also need final image assets (1200x675 for LI, 1200x628 for X).
Alex Chen: No embargo. Post in both regions. Creative: Maria — can you upload 2 hero images (one cost theme, one latency theme) to the drive and name them `micro-hero-cost.png` and `micro-hero-latency.png`?
Maria Gupta: On it. Uploading now -> https://drive.google.com/creative/micro-hero-uploads
launch-bot: Event created on calendar: "Micro-webinar: Production Inference Tactics" 2025-09-22 11:00 PT — attendees: marketing, growth, sdr. Calendar link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/2312
Jonah Lee: Scheduling snippet for ops: 
```
X post A (cost) -> 2025-09-22 11:00 PT
X post B (latency) -> 2025-09-22 11:10 PT
X thread replies -> +2min, +6min
LinkedIn post -> 2025-09-22 11:05 PT
Engagement follow-up window -> 11:10-13:00 PT (Emmy + SDRs)
```
Priya Nair: Seedlist note: I removed duplicate accounts and marked timezone. CSV ready for download. Will hand to SDR queue after we confirm posts.
Emmy Park: I'll create a shared Google Sheet for live engagement triage and tag priorities. Will post link here once ready.
Maria Gupta: Uploaded images and two copy variants: https://drive.google.com/creative/micro-hero-uploads (files: micro-hero-cost.png, micro-hero-latency.png, copy_A.txt, copy_B.txt)
Alex Chen: Final call — we go with A/B on the X headline, latency hero for variant B, cost hero for A. Emmy, SDRs get the seedlist + triage sheet after we hit publish.
Emmy Park: I’ll set up the triage sheet and Slack huddle channel `#microwebinar-engage` and invite SDRs.
Amanda O'Neill: FYI I'm scheduling crosspost in Buffer at the times above and will attach correct UTMs.
Jonah Lee: One more ask — can we pin the registration link in the first thread reply on X?
Alex Chen: Yep. Add as first reply and pin.
Maria Gupta: Done — pinned on the draft account.
Emmy Park: All set on my side. SDRs briefed.
Alex Chen: Huge, thanks everyone :tada: :thumbsup:
Maria Gupta: Small follow-up — analytics tag: `campaign=microwebinar_sep2025` (please add to all paid boosts too).
Amanda O'Neill: Noted. Will include in boost config.
Jonah Lee: Ready to publish — leaving this thread open for any last-minute changes. :rocket:
